title: Find the Longest Secure Substring
real_world_story: A password analyzer evaluates a password to determine the longest continuous section in which every character is unique. Such analysis helps measure the structural variety of an authentication string.

real_world_connection.target_represents: Longest continuous substring containing no repeated characters
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: A sliding window with character tracking to maintain the longest substring with unique characters

problem_statement: Given a string representing a password, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.
task: Determine the maximum length of a continuous substring in which every character occurs at most once.
input_format: The input contains a single string S.
output_format: Print the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
constraints: S contains only English letters and digits

examples.explanation: The longest substrings without repeated characters include 'abc', which has length 3.
The longest substring without repeated characters is 'ecurit', which has length 6.

expected_algorithm.name: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
expected_algorithm.reason: A sliding window with character tracking efficiently maintains the longest substring containing unique characters.

complexity.where: K is the number of distinct characters in the input.

hint: Maintain a window containing only unique characters.
Track the most recent position of each character.
When a repeated character appears, move the left side of the window forward.
Keep track of the maximum window length.
real_world_takeaway: Longest-substring analysis can help password analyzers measure character diversity and identify continuous sections with unique characters.
